description: Apply user tags to a MusicBrainz entity on YOUR account (needs OAuth: MUSICBRAINZ_OAUTH_* with the `tag` scope). Default `vote: upvote` adds the tags; `downvote` opposes them; `withdraw` removes your vote. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). The preview shows the exact XML; nothing is sent before confirmation. Data from MusicBrainz (https://musicbrainz.org), the open music encyclopedia.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

mbid.description: MBID of the entity to tag

name: musicbrainz_submit_tags
title: Submit user tags to MusicBrainz
